body: ALEXIS, queen and first of the vampires, leader of the Calabim in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: vampire, once human; woman; ageless, looking about thirty; tall and poised. Porcelain-pale skin, fine dark brows, glossy black hair swept up in a coil of braids, dull gold-yellow eyes.
costume: a crimson velvet gown with a high standing collar of black lace, a long black velvet mantle trimmed in silver, a ruby brooch at her throat.
signature: A slender silver CROWN SET WITH BLOOD-RED RUBIES is always on her brow.
extra: She has the stillness of something that no longer breathes: she does not blink and her shoulders never rise or fall. Whatever she wears is closed high at the throat, and no blood and no fangs show anywhere in the picture.

vibes.name: Death's Student
vibes.line: Leaning toward the viewer, her right hand holding one candle up near your face, her left writing in an open notebook without looking, lips parted, unblinking gold eyes fixed on yours; plundered books in a dark library gallery, dusk dying crimson in a tall window.
vibes.wears: a scholar's long robe of dark ink-blue velvet over a high-necked black dress, narrow silver buttons to the throat, ink stains on one cuff.

vibes.name: Fear of Dying
vibes.line: Both hands cupped around a candle burned down to a stub, shielding its shrinking flame from the wind, shoulders drawn in, lips pressed tight, gold eyes wide and fixed on the flame; an open palace balcony in the cold blue hour before dawn.
vibes.wears: a long white linen nightgown buttoned to the throat and wrists, a heavy dove-grey wool shawl wrapped tight around her shoulders.

vibes.name: Specimen Collector
vibes.line: Her right hand pressing a silver pin through a pale moth onto black velvet, her left holding the glass lid open, head tilted, a faint considering smile, eyes lifted to the viewer, measuring the next specimen; a curtained cabinet room of moth cases, grey afternoon light through one parted curtain.
vibes.wears: a fitted gown of deep bottle-green silk with a high collar of black velvet, long black kid gloves, a jeweller's lens on a silver chain at her waist.

vibes.name: First Vampire
vibes.line: Seated utterly still in an ancient high-backed chair, both hands holding a silver candle snuffer across her lap, face calm as marble, gold eyes level and unblinking on the viewer; a vaulted crypt at midnight, hundreds of candle stubs, most burned out, a few lighting her from below.
vibes.wears: a centuries-old court gown of crimson brocade faded to dusty rose, a tall stiff collar of tarnished silver lace, old rings on every finger.
